subject: Post-call recap + proposal: alternating global demo windows
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurora-analytics.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@aurora-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-12T23:00:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap + proposal: alternating global demo windows

Hi Liam / Priya —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for walking through Aurora's inference pain points and traffic patterns. Quick recap and a suggested path forward so we can lock the next session (technical deep dive + environment review).

Recap (3 bullets):
- Primary goals: reduce per-token cost on user-facing chat, tighten tail-latency to <150ms p95 for interactive flows, and keep customer data in EU regions where required.
- Workload: mixed short chat (60–150 tokens) + occasional long-form summarization (2–4k tokens).
- Key constraints: procurement window ~Dec, security review happening alongside; need a short technical deep dive for infra/arch Qs.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical deep dive with platform engineer + solutions lead. Because your team spans NA / EU / APAC, I propose a recurring alternating windows approach so the same Redwood engineers can hit reasonable hours for each region. Suggested rotating slots (pick one as the kickoff):

Option A (US-friendly week):
- Tue 09:00–10:15 PT (12:00–13:15 ET) — good for Aurora west-coast and US ops

Option B (EU-friendly week):
- Wed 15:00–16:15 CET (06:00–07:15 PT) — cover London/Amsterdam-based staff

Option C (APAC-friendly week):
- Fri 09:30–10:45 SGT/AEST (00:30–01:45 UTC) — early for Redwood APAC, regular hours for your Sydney/Singapore folks

Mechanics: we can rotate weekly (A → B → C) or run a 2-week cadence (A & B week 1, C week 2) depending on your calendar preference. For the kickoff, tell me which slot you prefer and who from Aurora will attend (technical owners + procurement observer is fine).

I've attached a short mutual action plan draft so we can align owners and deliverables. Also attaching a .ics with the three proposed slots so you can drop one into calendars to check conflicts.

Attachments: aurora-map-v1.xlsx (MAP draft, 42KB), proposed-demo-rotation.ics (3 slots)

Next steps: please reply with: 1) preferred kickoff slot; 2) attendees for the deep dive; 3) any must-have agenda items (e.g., SOC2 evidence, SSO, or network peering).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurora-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@aurora-analytics.com>
Date: 2025-11-13T08:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal: alternating global demo windows

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear summary. Priya and I chatted briefly and we like the alternating-window idea. A couple of constraints from our side:

- Can't do anything before 08:00 GMT on weekdays (our legal team is in Dublin).
- Prefer to have our infra lead (Raj Patel) and a product manager (Clara Nguyen) on the call — Raj can only join US-friendly or EU-friendly slots, not the APAC morning slot.
- Procurement wants an initial commercial head-nod before final tech deep dive — can you outline what the typical follow-ups from a demo look like (SOW/PO timeline)?

For kickoff, Option B (Wed 15:00 CET) looks ideal for Raj + Clara. If we rotate, can we avoid the Friday APAC slot for the first two iterations? We want Raj present for the first two technical sessions.

If that works, Priya will send Raj/Clara calendar availability; I can tentatively hold Wed 15:00 CET next week.

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform Partnerships
Aurora Analytics
liam.oconnor@aurora-analytics.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-13T17:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal: alternating global demo windows

Vanessa / team —

Thanks, noted. Rishi (platform solutions) and I can cover the deep dive. Quick notes from ops standpoint:

- We can run the deep dive as a 75-minute session: 15m agenda + 40m demo/arch walk + 20m Q&A/security deep dive.
- For the first two iterations, we'll keep APAC slot as "observe-only" and optionally record; full APAC-engaged session can start on iteration 3. That matches Liam's ask for Raj to attend first two.
- Typical commercial follow-ups after a demo: short SOW draft + proposed reserved capacity sizing within 3 business days (if both sides agree to move forward), initial security packet & SOC2 evidence within 5 business days for procurement review.

I'll hold the following team availability:
- Rishi Malhotra (platform solutions lead) — available Wed 15:00 CET next week and Tue 09:00 PT the following week.
- Neha Kapoor — can cover and should attend any of the options.

If Priya confirms attendees, I can accept the Wed 15:00 CET kickoff and we will send a calendar invite with the rotating series cadence A→B→C weekly.

—
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Perfect — thanks Priya. Wed 15:00 CET is locked as the kickoff. I've: 
- Created a recurring calendar series with the A→B→C weekly rotation (you should see the .ics attached)
- Set agenda: 1) 15m quick recap & objectives, 2) 40m demo + architecture & KV caching discussion, 3) 20m Q&A/security path & next commercial steps
- Confirmed attendees from Redwood: Vanessa Ortiz (AE), Neha Kapoor (Solutions), Rishi Malhotra (Platform solutions) — we'll have one of us handle the procurement questions.

Next operational notes:
- We will record the session and share notes.
- I'll follow up within 48 hours with a one-page high-level commercial timeline and a redlined MAP (attached: aurora-map-v1.xlsx).

Attachments included in this thread: aurora-map-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), proposed-demo-rotation.ics (recurring slots).
